title: software development
body:
[[YAGNI Principle]]
[[Microservices]]
[[Agile]]

The act of building the software, as opposed to software *engineering*, which is the
discipline around it. The distinction the course draws: development is writing the code,
engineering is the [[SDLC]], the [[Models]], the [[Review]] steps, and the argument about
[[Coupling and Cohesion]] that decides whether the code is still changeable in two years.

Everything under [[Design]] and [[Paradigms]] is about how to do this part so the
maintenance phase does not eat the project.
